question: Do the hashtag and SemEval datasets contain only English data?

evidence: We use two datasets for experiments (Table TABREF29 ): (a) STAN INLINEFORM0 , created by BIBREF10 BansalBV15, which consists of 1,108 unique English hashtags from 1,268 randomly selected tweets in the Stanford Sentiment Analysis Dataset BIBREF36 along with their crowdsourced segmentations and our additional corrections; and (b) STAN INLINEFORM1 , our new expert curated dataset, which includes all 12,594 unique English hashtags and their associated tweets from the same Stanford dataset.

title: Multi-task Pairwise Neural Ranking for Hashtag Segmentation
answer_rationale: Text 2 and Text 3 explicitly state that both the STAN datasets (used for hashtag segmentation) and the SemEval 2017 dataset contain only English hashtags and tweets. Text 4 also confirms that although the methods are language-independent, the focus was on English hashtags.
